Name: Upgrader
Author: soda5cm
Description:
[size=5][b]Upgrader[/b][/size]

Feeling lucky? [b]Upgrader[/b] lets you stake an item, pick a more valuable one and spin the wheel. Land on green and your item turns into the target. Miss, and it burns.

[b]Available in English and Russian.[/b]

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Craft the [b]Upgrader[/b] (5 Copper Bars + 1 Iron Bar). The recipe is known from the start.[/*]
[*]Hold it and press the use or action button to open the menu.[/*]
[*]Pick your [b]stake[/b] from your inventory (the whole stack counts) and a [b]target[/b] from the catalog of every item in the game.[/*]
[*]Press [b]Upgrade[/b] and watch the pointer.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Chance = 90% × (stake value ÷ target value)[/b], kept between 0.1% and 90%. Values are the item's sell price, so quality and stack size count. A downgrade is never guaranteed, and a long shot is never impossible.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A wheel shows your chance as a green arc. The pointer spins and stops inside it on a win, or outside it on a loss.[/*]
[*][b]Add gold[/b] to your stake with the slider to raise your chance.[/*]
[*][b]Quick picks[/b]: x2 / x4 / x8 choose a target worth that much more, and 30% / 55% / 75% choose a target for that chance.[/*]
[*][b]Search[/b] and page through the catalog: objects, weapons, boots and big craftables.[/*]
[*][b]Win effects[/b]: a flash, confetti, coins, sparkles and light rays behind your new item, plus a bigger show for wins under 25%.[/*]
[*][b]Lose effects[/b]: the card shakes and goes up in smoke.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: every win is announced in everyone's chat, e.g. [i]"soda5cm upgraded Diamond x3 into Tiger Slime Egg! The chance was 25.3%"[/i]. Each player sees it in their own language.[/*]
[*]The menu scales down to fit small screens and large UI scales.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config ([font=Courier New]config.json[/font])[/b][/size]
Option — Default — What it does
[font=Courier New]ChanceMultiplier[/font] — 0.9 — Chance = this × stake ÷ target
[font=Courier New]MinChance[/font] / [font=Courier New]MaxChance[/font] — 0.001 / 0.9 — Lowest and highest possible chance
[font=Courier New]AllowGold[/font] — true — Allow adding gold to the stake
[font=Courier New]SpinSeconds[/font] — 4 — How long the wheel spins
[font=Courier New]AnnounceWins[/font] — true — Post wins to chat in multiplayer

Console command: [font=Courier New]upgrader[/font] opens the menu.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[/list]
Inspired by the "Upgrader" mechanic of skin-trading sites and the Minecraft mod of the same name. All items here are in-game only.
